heroSummary: Metro Nashville Public Schools starts the 2025–26 student year Tuesday, August 5, 2025. Grades 1–12 attend full days August 5 and 6, while Pre-K and kindergarten attend half days; Thursday, August 7 is a full day for all grades. Fall Break runs October 13–17, Thanksgiving Holiday November 24–28, Winter Break December 22–January 2, and Spring Break March 9–13. Thursday, May 21 is the last day and a half day for all students.

customSections.label: How MNPS Stockpiled and Snow Make-Up Days Work
customSections.content: The updated calendar lists seven stockpiled professional-development days and six stockpiled inclement-weather days. It says potential snow make-up days may use stockpiled PD days, holidays, and other dates, but it does not publish a fixed candidate sequence. October 10 is already printed as a student day out under the District Discretional Stockpiled Inclement Weather Day label; other potential dates are excluded until MNPS announces a change.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Metro Nashville Public Schools start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day was Tuesday, August 5, 2025. Grades 1–12 attended full days on August 5 and 6, while Pre-K and kindergarten attended half days. August 7 was the first full day for all grades.

calendarFaqs.q: When did MNPS students return after Winter Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. January 5 was a stockpiled professional-development day, so students returned Tuesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When was MNPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran March 9–13, 2026. Students returned Monday, March 16. April 3 was a separate Spring Holiday when the district was closed.

calendarFaqs.q: Were December and May exam half days for all MNPS students?
calendarFaqs.a: Not all of them. December 16–18 and May 18–20 were half days only for grades 9–12 exams; Pre-K–8 attended full days. December 19 and May 21 were half days for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: What was the October 10 stockpiled weather date?
calendarFaqs.a: The updated calendar labeled October 10 a District Discretional Stockpiled Inclement Weather Day. Its calendar color showed students out of school, but not a districtwide office closure.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of school for MNPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Thursday, May 21, 2026 was the last student day. It was a half day for all students, and grades 9–12 had exams.
